name: routes_not_loaded

steps.text: Open the Logs tab. Traefik logs the router it rejected and why, usually a rule it can’t parse.
Fix the rule in Configuration and apply again, or roll back to the last revision that was ready.
A file you added to this folder also causes this, when it holds a router or Traefik can’t read it. Move that file out of the folder.

title: Traefik hasn’t loaded the routes Stackly wrote
